[font=Arial][size=2]Tired of missing dig spots all the time? I Know I was... If you're blind like me or just don't mind cheating a wee little bit then this mod is for you!

Adds a red rotating circle around the worms that signal a dig spot. 

Using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], a portion of "Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb" is replaced with my edited versions.[/size][/font][size=2][font=Arial]

[/font][/size]


[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img]
[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]1)[/b] [/color][/size][font=Arial][size=2]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]2)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Download and/or update [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url][size=2].[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Download and/or update [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=2].﻿[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]4)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains ShinnyWorms.png, content.json, & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] NoFogBob's Worms - Shinny Redux"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size][font=Arial][size=2]
